visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of glistening whole roasted ducks hanging inside a large cylindrical metal oven. (2) A person wearing white gloves uses a sharp knife to carefully slice thin pieces of crispy skin and meat from a duck. (3) Blurred background shows customers dining at tables in a clean, modern restaurant with warm lighting; a steaming ceramic pot is in the foreground. (4) Close-up of duck slices being plated on a white dish, followed by chopsticks picking up a piece of meat. (5) A gloved hand holds a thin pancake, places duck meat, cucumber, and green onion on it, then wraps it up. (6) The wrap is dipped into a small white dish containing a dark, thick soy-based sauce. (7) An arm is seen tossing pieces of duck and vegetables in a wok over a high blue gas flame in a kitchen. (8) A large bowl of congee containing duck meat and red beans is stirred with a spoon, steam rising from it. (9) Close-ups of golden fried spring rolls and cubes of spicy duck blood in a red chili oil broth are shown. (10) A collection of white and black takeaway containers filled with various duck dishes is displayed on a table. (11) A wide shot pans across the restaurant's interior featuring white walls, high-backed chairs, and decorative pendant lights. (12) Exterior shot of the restaurant with a white facade and a logo featuring a cartoon duck.

The background music is a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. (2) As the narration describes the crispy skin, a subtle 'crunch' sound effect is layered in, and a short 'whoosh' SFX marks the transition to the next food shot. The voice remains consistent in pitch and high energy. (3) The rhythmic music continues steadily without gaps, providing a positive atmosphere. The narrator details the ingredients of the congee and spring rolls with clear articulation and rising intonation at the end of descriptive phrases. (4) In the final phase, the narration provides location details and a social media handle. A small 'pop' SFX is heard as the final graphics appear, and the music fades out smoothly.
